contractSign.partySellerBody: Modern Delta Farms, agricultural registration no. 45992, located in Dakahlia Governorate. Legally represented by Mr. Mohamed Abdullah.
contractSign.clause1Body: The second party undertakes to supply yellow maize to the first party in a quantity of 500 metric tons, according to the following technical specifications validated by the automated conformity system:
contractSign.clause1Item4: Crop free of insect and fungal infestation.
contractSign.clause2Title: Article 2: Total value and payment method
contractSign.clause2Body: The parties agree that the price per ton is 15,000 EGP, bringing the total contract value to 7,500,000 Egyptian pounds (seven million five hundred thousand Egyptian pounds only). Payment shall be made in installments linked to the attached delivery schedule via the NileChain platform.
contractSign.clause3Body: Delivery shall be made to the first party’s warehouses within a maximum of 30 days from the date of signing this contract. In case of delay, a late penalty of 1% per week of delay applies to the delayed installment value. The first party may reject any shipment that does not meet the specifications in Article 1.
